title: Le faux casting de James Bond  (The Fake James Bond Casting)

segments.t: Following a frustrating meeting where Fabrice Luchini refused to switch agencies, Andrea meets with Mathias and Gabriel to strategize. Realizing that Fabrice has always dreamed of playing a villain in a James Bond film, they hatch a daring plan. They decide to use actress Linda Gérard to pose as the legendary James Bond casting director and trick Fabrice into believing his agent failed him. Listen to the scene in French first. Don't worry about catching every word.
Alors Andréa, comment s'est passé le rendez-vous?
Il a campé sur ses positions.
Il faut discréditer son agent Bréhier.
Qu'est-ce qui manque à Fabrice?
Une carrière internationale dans James Bond.
Il rêve de jouer un méchant!
Faisons croire que Bréhier a raté ce contrat.
La directrice s'appelle Debbie MacWilliams.
Est-ce que Fabrice la connaît personnellement?
Non, il ne l'a jamais vue.
Notre actrice Linda Gérard lui ressemble.
Elle parle parfaitement anglais avec l'accent.
Envoyer une fausse directrice de casting?
C'est notre seule chance de réussir!
D'accord, mais restons très discrets.
Let's walk through the conversation step by step.
Alors Andréa, comment s'est passé le rendez-vous?
'So Andrea, how did the meeting go?' Gabriel opens by asking how the discussion with Luchini went.
Il a campé sur ses positions.
'He dug his heels in.' Andrea describes how obstinate and inflexible Fabrice proved to be.
Il faut discréditer son agent Bréhier.
'We must discredit his agent Bréhier.' Mathias insists that undermining his current agent is the only way forward.
Qu'est-ce qui manque à Fabrice?
'What does Fabrice lack?' Gabriel asks what is the unfulfilled desire or dream Luchini still holds.
Une carrière internationale dans James Bond.
'An international career in James Bond.' Mathias identifies the elusive global film role that Fabrice secretly covets.
Il rêve de jouer un méchant!
'He dreams of playing a villain!' Andrea emphasizes that playing a 007 antagonist is his biggest ambition.
Faisons croire que Bréhier a raté ce contrat.
'Let's make him believe Bréhier missed this contract.' Gabriel proposes inventing a story about Bréhier blowing the negotiation.
La directrice s'appelle Debbie MacWilliams.
'The casting director is called Debbie MacWilliams.' Mathias mentions the real name of the iconic James Bond casting director.
Est-ce que Fabrice la connaît personnellement?
'Does Fabrice know her personally?' Andrea asks whether Luchini has ever met her face to face.
Non, il ne l'a jamais vue.
'No, he has never seen her.' Gabriel confirms that Fabrice would not recognize the real casting director.
Notre actrice Linda Gérard lui ressemble.
'Our actress Linda Gérard looks like her.' Andrea suggests recruiting their bilingual client Linda Gérard for the stunt.
Elle parle parfaitement anglais avec l'accent.
'She speaks English perfectly with the accent.' Gabriel highlights Linda's authentic Scottish background.
Envoyer une fausse directrice de casting?
'Send a fake casting director?' Mathias questions the sanity and legality of sending an impostor.
C'est notre seule chance de réussir!
'It is our only chance to succeed!' Andrea argues passionately that this bold bluff is their only viable option.
D'accord, mais restons très discrets.
'All right, but let us stay very discreet.' Mathias reluctantly agrees while demanding total secrecy. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.
